movelist.name: Bulldoze
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are lowered 1 Speed Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Rock Tomb
movelist.effect: Rock Tomb lowers the target’s Speed by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Imprison
movelist.effect: The target is Locked for the rest of the Scene. A Locked target may not use any Moves the user knows. Imprison cannot miss.

movelist.name: Mud Shot
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowed by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Block
movelist.effect: The target is Stuck and Trapped until the beginning of your next turn.

movelist.name: Punishment
movelist.effect: Punishment’s Damage Base is raised by +1 for each positive Combat Stage the target has, to a maximum of DB 12.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.effect: While on sandy terrain or in Sandstorms, the user’s Ground, Rock, and Steel-Typed damaging moves deal +5 Damage.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.effect: Whenever the user has its Combat Stages lowered, by something other than its own Moves or Abilities, the user’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.
